title: EMS Network Interface Configuration
description: Network interface configuration for the ECU-1170-552A. Configures eth0 (WAN/cloud) and eth1 (LAN/device network) with support for DHCP or static IP assignment. If mode is 'static', address, netmask, and gateway are required.

_schema_version.description: Schema version for migration detection. Must match the schema expected version.

interfaces.description: Network interface configurations keyed by interface name.

eth0.description: Primary Ethernet interface (WAN). Typically connected to the site network or cellular router for cloud connectivity.

mode.description: IP address assignment mode. 'static' requires manual address configuration; 'dhcp' obtains address automatically from a DHCP server.

address.description: Static IPv4 address for this interface. Required when mode='static'. Example: 192.168.1.100

netmask.description: Subnet mask for static IP configuration. Example: 255.255.255.0

gateway.description: Default gateway IP address for static IP configuration. Example: 192.168.1.1

dns.description: DNS server IP addresses. List of up to 3 DNS servers. Example: [8.8.8.8, 8.8.4.4]

eth1.description: Secondary Ethernet interface (LAN). Connects to the internal device network: PCS, BTMS, meters, and other Modbus TCP devices.

mode.description: IP address assignment mode. 'static' requires manual address configuration; 'dhcp' obtains address automatically.

address.description: Static IPv4 address for this interface. Required when mode='static'. Example: 192.168.2.1

netmask.description: Subnet mask for static IP configuration. Example: 255.255.255.0

gateway.description: Default gateway for static IP configuration (optional for LAN-only interface).

dns.description: DNS server IP addresses for this interface.
